records.geographic_disambiguation: Primary historical JICA cartography supports the selected middle corridor along Río San Juan, the downstream junction into Río Yaque del Sur, and the lower Yaque approach to the Caribbean coast north of Barahona and east of Laguna Rincón. This is more than nearby-label or basin matching, but it is not a completed whole-route identity. The first mountain component and its full connection to the Sabaneta reach are not securely resolved in readable original cartography. The acquired historical maps also predate Montegrande, which INDRHI reports began operation in 2024; its reservoir passage has not been cartographically reconciled with this selected route. The primary status is source-material pending, with no additional access-pending or completed scope-hold classification.

component_scope_limits: The retained line combines upstream San Juan and downstream Yaque del Sur reaches. A receiving-river label does not rename the San Juan reach.

The initial mountain segments remain unnamed in this finding because readable original-map correspondence is incomplete. Author-hosted park-plan prose about the southeast-to-northwest upper San Juan is supporting context, not sufficient to settle the selected starting tributary or every connection.

Sabaneta is a separately identified dam/reservoir setting on San Juan. Sabana Yegua is a separate Yaque del Sur dam upstream of the mapped junction; it is not assigned to the selected San Juan route merely because the rivers meet below it.
Montegrande is a separate modern impoundment on Yaque del Sur. The older channel depiction does not establish its present reservoir extent or the selected inlet-to-outlet passage.
Laguna Rincón is a separate lateral waterbody in the lower plain. Its name, and the names of neighboring irrigation canals, are not applied to the coastal river course.
No accepted name, Korean form, official registry status, exact banks, contemporary discharge condition or uniform hydronym is established.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
